info.syllabusName: Business Computing_ Công nghệ thông tin trong kinh doanh
info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
1. Course Objectives:

This course provides students with the essential computing foundation for Fintech. The course focuses on developing basic programming skills in Python, SQL to analyze data, manage databases, and perform statistical computing, equipping students with the fundamental tools to solve problems and succeed in the fast-growing FinTech industry. By the end of this course, students will gain the technical proficiency needed to support roles in data-driven financial analysis, algorithmic trading, and financial application development.

2. Course Content:

Key topics include: Fundamentals of Programming and Data Analysis in Business; Fundamentals of Python programming; Fundamentals of R programming; Foundation of SQL for data management; Integrating Python and SQL.

3. Activities and Teaching Methodology:

Lectures, hands-on coding sessions, and individual and group projects to practice the application of programming techniques using Python, SQL enabling them to apply their skills in practical, job-oriented scenarios.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Promptly access to the http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

materials.materialDescription: Python Data Analytics with Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
materials.author: Fabio Nelli

materials.materialDescription: SQL for Data Analytics: Perform fast and efficient data analysis with the power of SQL
materials.author: Upom Malik, Matt Goldwasser, Benjamin Johnston

clos.loDetails: Describe fundamental programming concepts (variables, data types, control structures) and the role of coding in business analytics.
Collaborate effectively in team-based tasks and communicate coding-based business analysis results in a clear and professional manner.
Perform data import/export operations to load datasets from Excel/CSV files into Python environment.
Apply conditional logic and loops in Python scripts to automate repetitive financial calculation tasks.
Construct SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY clauses to retrieve precise datasets.
Employ Python libraries (NumPy, Pandas) to manipulate tabular data, handling missing values.
Compute key business metrics using SQL aggregation functions (SUM, AVG) and table joins.
Analyze business trends and patterns by interpreting data visualizations generated via Python tools.
Integrate SQL queries within Python scripts to extract and process data, distinguishing their specific roles.
